senses.definition: (video games, in a visual novel) A unique, static full-screen image, usually displayed to illustrate a significant event in the story.
senses.example: Plenty of CGs pad out the adventure too, with beautiful art depicting the events that take place.

senses.definition: Cloud-to-ground lightning; lightning which connects (attaches) to the ground; lightning which results in the discharge of electricity between a cloud and the ground.
To create visuals using computer-generated imagery; to apply visual effects.
senses.example: When a Transformer turns into a car, do you think it's a real car or was it also CGIed?
